description: This file defines the interface for the OSP Unit API, providing function prototypes for retrieving device information such as ID, serial number, model, SKU, hardware and platform versions, software version, vendor details, manufacturer, factory, manufacturing date, DHCP hostname, and security schema support.

methods.name: osp_unit_id_get
methods.description: Retrieves device identification as a null-terminated string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_serial_get
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number as a null-terminated string, typically derived from MAC address, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_model_get
methods.description: Retrieves device model identifier, possibly returning CONFIG_TARGET_MODEL, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_sku_get
methods.description: Retrieves device SKUs as a null-terminated string; returns false if not supported.

methods.name: osp_unit_hw_revision_get
methods.description: Retrieves hardware revision number as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_platform_version_get
methods.description: Retrieves platform version number as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_sw_version_get
methods.description: Retrieves software version number in specified format, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_name_get
methods.description: Retrieves vendor name as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_part_get
methods.description: Retrieves vendor part number as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_manufacturer_get
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturer name as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_factory_get
methods.description: Retrieves factory name as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_mfg_date_get
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturing date in 'YYYY/WW' format as a string, part of the AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_dhcpc_hostname_get
methods.description: Retrieves hostname string for DHCP client in <SERIAL>_<MODEL> format.

methods.name: osp_unit_sec_schema_is_legacy
methods.description: Returns whether the security schema is legacy (true) or not (false).
